research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Berbix is focused on enhancing identity verification through advanced authentication systems. Their R&D efforts include methods to verify the identity of a person by analyzing image pixels of authentication documents. Additionally, they are developing systems to authenticate documents using image capture data and virtual images, detecting identification indicators within these images. These innovations aim to streamline the verification process, ensuring robust and efficient identity checks.

overview_description.description:
Berbix is a document identity verification solution that helps businesses accelerate growth and stay compliant at the same time by instantly and accurately validating photo IDs, driver licenses, and passports. Berbix helps to improve customer acquisition funnels with its automated and multifaceted verification solution that can confirm a user’s identity in 2 seconds and be implemented in as little as one afternoon. 

Berbix was founded in 2018 by the former product and engineering leaders of Trust & Safety at Airbnb and is backed by Y-combinator, Initialized Capital, Mayfield Fund, and others. Berbix supports businesses in the micro-mobility, fintech, age-restricted goods, and healthcare industries in customizing the way they fight fraud, stay compliant, and accelerate growth. Founded by the former product and engineering leaders for Trust & Safety at Airbnb and backed by Y Combinator and Initialized Capital, Berbix sits at the intersection of identity and fraud. They take an industry-specific approach to help customers customize and control the way they fight fraud through scalable hosted tools.

The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
